answer: Rule: cap every identity's payout by a ferrous stake lock. An identity may earn at most half its locked stake per epoch, so a fake chasing 100 POA must first lock 200 POA of its own. Each stake is public on a cedar ledger, and any identity sharing a funding wallet with another forfeits its whole lock. The stake is the signal: one operator locks once and earns steadily, while a sybil ring must lock 200 POA per fake, so cost scales linearly.
